# Goal
Souji round 25, wave 2 (falsify wave-1 artifacts, claims, counters and source rows). Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin. Lane: fleet repository & workspace hygiene. Axes: calibration (7, lowest), operability (8), coverage (8); no axis harmed. L1 holds planner seat and integrates.

# Hard bound
Read-only W2 seats write only their own report under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/w2/. No lane file edits, no git/jj mutations, no fleet or sibling writes. Never delete/move/quarantine/classify-for-cleanup anything outside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/. Do not inspect `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow` or any operator-sweep / `.scratch/` / `.ufo/state/` contents. No credentials, no live `/proc`, no signals. Scratch only `/var/tmp/souji-r25-<YourName>/`, remove it before finish. No tool installations unless needed; if needed read `/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md` first; pacman is paused.

# Round contract
Round prompt: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/prompts/souji-round-25.md. Frozen claim spec and append-only amendments: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/preregistration.txt and `preregistration-amendment-(1, 2, 3).txt`. Read them first. Never change or narrow a claim predicate, target or case set; report attacks only. The W1 integration draft is currently in the lane tree; inspect actual bytes and receipt outputs, not seat assertions. A claim's admission belongs to L1. Wave output is advisory.

# Evidence and paths
Tools start at the fleet root. Use absolute lane paths. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin; write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>. Python in lane: `python3 -B`. Numeric results include exact command/revision. A quote needs exact location and <=25-word verbatim quote. Every fresh task starts `/skill:godspeed` plus the host directive. Leaves only; no subagent spawning.

# Attack objectives
Each item attacks one named W1 artifact or a specific frozen claim/control. Re-run only the item’s bounded counter/probe, in isolated `/var/tmp/souji-r25-<YourName>/` scratch. No production writes. Report `STATUS: PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL`, evidence, numbered findings, attack log. Never alter expected predicates or silently repair a false green.
